standards.name: Picogrid Standard Terms and Conditions, the only terms document that exists
standards.notes: The clauses were extracted from the PDF OUTSIDE this tree (FlateDecode content streams, Type0/CIDFontType2 glyph ids resolved through the document's own three ToUnicode CMaps, 80 entries); no fetched byte is committed. The opening sentence is what scopes all of it, and it is why M's questions 2 and 5 answer NOT STATED rather than NO: the Standard Terms are a contract with a Customer under an executed Order Form, this repository is not one, 5.1's restrictions bind "Customer", 1.6 defines "Product" as Picogrid's Software and Platform rather than the interface description, and 1.2 excludes from Confidential Information anything "publicly available through no fault of Customer", which the public OpenAPI document is. Nothing in the document addresses third-party use of the public interface description - and the absence of a grant is not a grant.
standards.quoted:
